title: Named subtests
hints: Most grading bugs are off-by-one errors. For every edge (`90`, `80`, `70`, `60`, `0`, `100`), test the value on each side of it.
Add a `name string` field to your table struct. Inside the loop, call `t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) { ... })` and put the check inside the closure. Remember the invalid scores `-1` and `101`.
